leadText: Pocket Monsters Platinum: Aim to Be Battle King!! (Japanese: ポケットモンスタープラチナ　めざせ!! バトル ) is a Pokémon manga by Ryū Matsushima. It follows the story of Yū Shirogane, a hot-blooded schoolboy who competitively plays the Nintendo DS game Pokémon Platinum Version in order to become the Battle King.
plainText:
Pocket Monsters Platinum: Aim to Be Battle King!! (Japanese: ポケットモンスタープラチナ　めざせ!! バトル ) is a Pokémon manga by Ryū Matsushima. It follows the story of Yū Shirogane, a hot-blooded schoolboy who competitively plays the Nintendo DS game Pokémon Platinum Version in order to become the Battle King.

==Publications==
The entire series was released as one collected volume. 
 
 

==List of chapters==
BATTLE.1: A Heated Battle Begins!!
BATTLE.2: Walkthrough! Battle Tower!!
BATTLE.3: The Ultimate Combination is Formed!!
BATTLE.4: Clash! Yū vs. The Wandering Player
BATTLE.5: Defeat the Legends!!
BATTLE.6: The Road to Becoming Battle King!!
BATTLE.7: Yū vs. Shin, Rival Showdown!!
FINAL BATTLE: Final Battle to Become King!!

==Notes==
This manga directly references the Cinema Shaymin distribution.
